title: Turn Off Taskbar News & Weather
description: Removes the news and weather widget from the taskbar to save memory and stop background lag.

title: Hide Taskbar Cortana Button
description: Hides the old Cortana assistant icon from the Windows 10 taskbar.

title: Turn Off Timeline & Activity History
description: Stops Windows 10 from constantly recording every app and file you open into a history log.
applyScript: $sys = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System'; if (!(Test-Path $sys)) { New-Item -Path $sys -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $sys -Name 'EnableActivityFeed' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $sys -Name 'PublishUserActivities' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $sys -Name 'UploadUserActivities' -Value 0 -Type DWord

title: Instant Start Menu Search
description: Stops Start Menu from searching the web on Bing. Finding local files and opening apps becomes instant.
applyScript: if (!(Test-Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer')) { New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' -Value 1 -Type DWord; if (!(Test-Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search')) { New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Name 'BingSearchEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Name 'CortanaConsent' -Value 0 -Type DWord
revertScript: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Name 'BingSearchEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Name 'CortanaConsent' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

title: Block Suggested Apps & Ads in Start
description: Stops Windows from automatically installing unwanted games or showing app ads in your Start Menu.
applyScript: $cdm = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager'; if (!(Test-Path $cdm)) { New-Item -Path $cdm -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SoftLandingEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
revertScript: $cdm = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager'; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path $cdm -Name 'SoftLandingEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

title: Stop Background Diagnostic Tracking
description: Pauses Windows background activity tracking when idle. Saves CPU and battery without breaking Windows Update.
applyScript: Stop-Service -Name 'DiagTrack' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service -Name 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Manual -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service -Name 'dmwappushservice' -StartupType Manual -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
revertScript: Set-Service -Name 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name 'DiagTrack' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service -Name 'dmwappushservice' -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

title: Turn Off Diagnostic Data Sharing
description: Limits diagnostic reporting sent to Microsoft to the absolute minimum required.

title: Turn Off Advertising Tracking ID
description: Stops Windows and apps from tracking your activity to show targeted ads.
applyScript: if (!(Test-Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo')) { New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo' -Name 'Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; if (!(Test-Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy')) { New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy' -Name 'TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord
revertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo' -Name 'Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy' -Name 'TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

title: Stop Game Stutter (Turn Off Background Recording)
description: Turns off Xbox background video recording, which stops sudden FPS drops and stutters while gaming.
applyScript: $gdvr = 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR'; if (!(Test-Path $gdvr)) { New-Item -Path $gdvr -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $gdvr -Name 'AppCaptureEnabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_Enabled' -Value 0 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (!(Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name 'AllowGameDVR' -Value 0 -Type DWord
revertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR' -Name 'AppCaptureEnabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name 'GameDVR_Enabled' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name 'AllowGameDVR' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

title: Smooth & Predictable Mouse Aim
description: Turns off mouse speed jumping so your cursor moves at an even, natural speed. Essential for gaming.
applyScript: $mouse = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '0' -Type String; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '0' -Type String; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '0' -Type String
revertScript: $mouse = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '1' -Type String; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '6' -Type String; Set-ItemProperty -Path $mouse -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '10' -Type String

title: Ultimate Performance Power Plan
description: Keeps your processor ready and responsive at all times without letting it slow down into idle mode.

title: Speed Up Graphics Card Processing
description: Lets your graphics card manage its own memory for lower input lag in modern games.

title: Maximize Download & Internet Speed
description: Optimizes internet connection settings so you get the full speed of your broadband connection.
checkScript: ((& netsh int tcp show global 2>$null) -match 'Receive Window Auto-Tuning Level\s*:\s*normal')
applyScript: & netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal 2>$null | Out-Null; & netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled 2>$null | Out-Null
revertScript: & netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal 2>$null | Out-Null

title: Faster Game & File Loading
description: Stops Windows from writing a timestamp every single time a file is read, speeding up SSD drive access.

title: Set BlueStacks 5 to 240 FPS
description: Unlocks high frame rate mode in BlueStacks so compatible mobile games run at up to 240 FPS.

revertScript: & powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 5 2>$null | Out-Null; & powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 ea062031-0e34-4ff1-9b6d-eb1059334028 100 2>$null | Out-Null; & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT 2>$null | Out-Null
title: Keep All CPU Cores Awake (Stops Stutter)
applyScript: & powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100 2>$null | Out-Null; & powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 ea062031-0e34-4ff1-9b6d-eb1059334028 100 2>$null | Out-Null; & powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT 2>$null | Out-Null
description: Stops processor cores from going to sleep while plugged in, preventing micro-stutters during heavy games.

revertScript: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization' -Name 'DODownloadMode' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service -Name 'DoSvc' -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name 'DoSvc' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
title: Stop Background Windows Update Uploads
applyScript: if (!(Test-Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization')) { New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization' -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization' -Name 'DODownloadMode' -Value 0 -Type DWord; Set-Service -Name 'DoSvc' -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name 'DoSvc' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
description: Stops Windows from using your internet upload bandwidth to send updates to other computers.

revertScript: $gpus = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($g in $gpus) { $pnp = $g.PNPDeviceID; if ($pnp) { $msiPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$pnp\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties"; if (Test-Path $msiPath) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $msiPath -Name 'MSISupported' -Value 0 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }
title: Direct Graphics Card Communication
applyScript: $gpus = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($g in $gpus) { $pnp = $g.PNPDeviceID; if ($pnp) { $msiPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum\$pnp\Device Parameters\Interrupt Management\MessageSignaledInterruptProperties"; if (!(Test-Path $msiPath)) { New-Item -Path $msiPath -Force | Out-Null }; Set-ItemProperty -Path $msiPath -Name 'MSISupported' -Value 1 -Type DWord -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }
description: Helps your graphics card talk directly to the processor without waiting in line, reducing input lag.
